note: The requirement ledger this project's builds are judged against (VALIDATION.md §2: geometry may not precede requirements, so build_part is refused while the ledger is empty). Replayed through cad_ops.record_requirements — the production writer — by hephaestus.testing.workspace_fixture.materialize_workspace_fixture. Every entry is source='specified' with the quote it came from, so none of them gates a build (§3 gates only 'assumed' entries) and the fixture's builds are never blocked on a clarification the browser gate cannot answer.
request: A flat-pack stair tread kit, laser cut from one sheet of Baltic birch plywood: a tread with anti-slip grooves and two cleats that carry it on the stringers.

entries.text: The kit is cut from a single sheet of Baltic birch plywood.
entries.quote: laser cut from one sheet of Baltic birch plywood

entries.text: The tread carries anti-slip grooves across its walking surface.
Two cleats support the tread on the stringers.
